$comment: Where this build of Fabricator is published and where it fetches from: its GitHub repository (releases, issues, source for Help), its documentation site, the auto-updater channel and signing key, and the repository rayfin-local is downloaded from. Everything reads these values from here; tauri.conf.json, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml and the Advisor rules keep copies, so after editing run `node scripts/distribution/sync.mjs`.
